review_evidence: README states the project formalizes the GL₂ Bruhat–Tits tree over a discretely valued field, proves it is a regular tree, formalizes Cartan decomposition and a Laplacian-surjectivity application.
27 of 28 Lean files contain proposition declarations spanning lattices, graph/tree structure, group actions, Cartan decomposition and harmonic cochains.
Named main results include BTtree, btgraph_regular, cartan_decomposition_unique and BTlaplace_surjective.
summary: Reviewed bruhat-tits; retain the formalization of the Bruhat–Tits tree and its applications.
